plan.major: Middle School Education: English Content Option
plan.notes: Source: 'Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog', BSE Middle School Education: English Content Option, SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog (PDF lines ~8157-8259). Catalog prints 'Total hours required for major - 120'; sequenced sum = 120. Footnote 1: MATH 1053 Mathematical Literacy preferred for the Mathematics slot (modeled as MATH 1023, first-listed). Two 'World Literature I/II (ENGL 2213 or ENGL 2223)' slots: Semester 3 satisfies general education (core), Semester 4 satisfies the language arts concentration (major). Footnote 3: language arts content must meet content requirements in the degree requirements; the three 'Language Arts Content' slots cover the 6-hour literature select and 3-hour writing select (modeled as ENGL 3583, first-listed). Footnote 4: professional elective options are in the degree requirements (additional concentration, TESOL certificate, or coaching endorsement). Semesters 5-6 literacy slots are paired 6-hour sequence choices per degree requirements (E ED 4173/EDUC 4203 with E ED 4273/EDUC 4113); the degree requirements print 'E ED 4273 - Teaching Literacy I' (apparent typo) while the plan correctly prints 'Teaching Literacy II'. Plan prints 'ENGL 4013 Secondary Language Acquisition' (requirements: 'Second Language Acquisition') - kept verbatim. REPEATS: the SAU 2025-2026 catalog's own BSE Middle School Education plan prints 'TEDU 4001 Professional Learning I' (Fall Semester 7) and 'TEDU 4001 Professional Learning II' (Spring Semester 8); kept verbatim as printed. Note the program requirements list identifies Professional Learning II as TEDU 4011. allow_repeated_courses set 2026-10-01.
